messages.subject: rApache latest release is 1.1.12
parts:
Well, I had to iterate a few releases to fix up a logging issue. In
1.1.10 the error log file was not getting written to properly, plus I
forgot to issue a flush. In 1.1.11 I switched to using apr_file_printf
which seemed to fix the problem, but it introduced another weirdness
whereby apr_file_printf(..."%*s",len,data) would read past the value
specified in len. Not sure why, so I fixed it in 1.1.12 by using
apr_file_write(...,data,len) which works beautifully.

The urgency in iteration was due to an immediate deployment need from a client.

You can get the latest release as always here:

http://www.rapache.net/downloads.html

Best,

Jeff
